$comment: Public FHIR sandbox allowlist for phi-lane-guard (change configure-phi-lanes). Reviewed by hipaa-privacy-officer. Each entry is a public, unauthenticated-by-default test server that never holds real patient data. Add a host only with a reason naming the sandbox program; never add a production or partner endpoint here.

sandboxes.reason: HAPI FHIR public test server (R4 base at /baseR4), operated by Smile Digital Health for community testing; synthetic/test data only.
SMART Health IT public R4 reference sandbox (SMART App Launch conformance testing); synthetic data only.
SMART Health IT app launcher for the public sandbox above; no patient data of its own.
Epic on FHIR public sandbox (open.epic.com), used for third-party app development against Epic's non-production test tenant.
Oracle Health (Cerner) public open sandbox for FHIR R4 conformance testing; synthetic patients only.
Oracle Health (Cerner) code console sandbox for SMART app development; synthetic patients only.
